capabilities: insert the current time into new bullet lines
configure the time format used for insertion
set a regex to detect whether the last bullet already contains a time
extras: Not yet available in the Obsidian plugin market; install via BRAT (Quorafind/obsidian-new-bullet-with-time) or manually. Developer solicits support via buy-me-a-coffee.
problem: Obsidian does not add timestamps to new bullet lines, so users keeping time-stamped logs must type the time manually.
summary: Bullet timestamp plugin that automatically inserts the current time on new bullet lines, with configurable time format.
